name: Chain Lightning

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: one creature you can see, then up to three others within 30 feet of it

summary: A bolt strikes one target and leaps to up to three more within 30 feet of it: Dex save, 10d8 Lightning each, half on a success.
text: Each extra slot level above 6 adds one more leap.
